entities.summary: People's Republic, a political institution in China during Republic of China and Warlord Era (1945–1949). Grew from Mao Zedong proclaims the People's Republic of China in Tiananmen Square and Nanjing Massacre — Japanese forces kill hundreds of thousands of civilians. Led to the emergence of Nationalist.
